bio: John Tyler, the tenth President of the United States, was the second husband of John's cousin Julia Gardiner. They married in June 1844; the accounts differ on whether the wedding took place on the 20th or the 26th of the month. He is connected to the family by marriage only, not by blood.

conflicts.found: 20 June 1844 (Gardiner 1890 p. 149) vs 26 June 1844 (Wikipedia, Julia Gardiner Tyler)
conflicts.assessment: Wikipedia's 26 June 1844 is the commonly cited date; Gardiner's '20' may be a misprint.
